issues.description: Module-level monkey-patch of genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE mutates a third-party private attribute at import time
issues.detail: Mutating a private underscore-prefixed attribute of google-genai at module import is a self-confessed 'temporary hack' that leaks process-global state to every consumer of pipecat. Use a supported HttpOptions/client configuration, pin the dependency, or file upstream. Do not ship private-attribute mutation as a permanent solution.

issues.description: image.tobytes() emitted with format='RGB' without convert('RGB') corrupts non-RGB PIL outputs
issues.detail: PIL opens PNGs in whatever mode the source uses (RGBA, P, L). Calling tobytes() while declaring format='RGB' produces buffers with wrong size and layout, breaking downstream renderers. Fix by calling image.convert('RGB') before tobytes(), or propagate image.mode as the frame format.

issues.description: Silent default model change from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash is a breaking behavioral shift
issues.detail: Existing callers who relied on the default now silently get different latency, pricing, and thinking-budget behavior on upgrade. The constructor signature offers no deprecation path. This bump belongs in its own PR or behind a staged deprecation, not buried inside an image-generation feature patch.

issues.description: Image-model detection by substring 'image' in model name is a fragile predicate
issues.detail: Gating _maybe_unset_thinking_budget on 'image' in self._model_name couples behavior to Google's naming convention. Future models like gemini-3-vision-image-understanding will silently match or miss. Extract an explicit is_image_generation_model() predicate, or use a capability registry, so the contract is named and testable.

issues.description: No error handling or size bound on inline image bytes from the model
issues.detail: part.inline_data.data is fed unconditionally to BytesIO and PIL.Image.open with no try/except, size cap, or validation. A malformed payload raises UnidentifiedImageError and aborts the whole context-processing loop; an oversized payload risks OOM. Wrap in try/except, log, and continue processing remaining parts.

issues.description: Emitting OutputImageRawFrame from GoogleLLMService extends the service's output contract without documentation
issues.detail: The supertype contract is text and tool-call streaming. Pushing OutputImageRawFrame mid-stream strengthens what downstream pipelines must accept without restating the postcondition. Document which model classes produce image frames and what ordering guarantees hold relative to LLMTextFrame and aggregator boundaries.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. Two P0 defects must be fixed before merge: a self-described monkey-patch of a private google-genai attribute at module import, and an image frame whose declared format='RGB' does not match what PIL actually decodes for non-RGB PNGs. Three P1s round out the consensus: a silent default-model bump that belongs in its own patch, a fragile substring-match predicate for image-model detection, and missing error handling around server-supplied image bytes. The feature shape is roughly right; the contracts and abstraction boundaries need to be named explicitly.
